concepts.quote: The task data are winter temperatures in Antarctica, they are always negative, so 0 is fine.
concepts.why: The student argues correctly that a start value of 0 gives the right minimum when no possible data value is above 0; this holds only if the domain assumption is true, and an empty array would still print 0.
The answer says nothing about primitive types as a concept.
